evidence: Modifies LoadBlockIndex in src/validation.cpp to enforce block index invariants for pruned blocks.
rationale: Enforces chainstate block-index invariants by ensuring LoadBlockIndex checks BLOCK_HAVE_DATA before adding blocks to m_blocks_unlinked. In v31.1, inserting pruned blocks whose parents are header-only causes nodes running with -checkblockindex to crash on an assertion failure during startup or block connection.
